otherKeywordsChecked.keyword: coloring pages for toddlers / toddler coloring pages
otherKeywordsChecked.note: Ubersuggest reports 0 volume (data gap, not real demand absence); target via "simple coloring pages" and on-page toddler/preschool wording

serpObservations: Crayola (DA 79) holds #1-2 on every head term checked (thanksgiving, dinosaur, winter, unicorn, simple coloring pages) and takes the bulk of clicks.

Small/mid coloring-page sites DO rank on page one: reallycolor.com (DA 27) is #3 for dinosaur and #4 for unicorn; cutecoloringpagesforkids.com (DA 28) is #3 for simple coloring pages; mondaymandala.com (DA 39) is top 6 on every term; coloringbliss.com (DA 32) #8-10; yaycoloringpages.com (DA 29) around #12-14.

Other recurring rankers: abcmouse.com (DA 67), homemade-gifts-made-easy.com (DA 65, strong on seasonal with heavy Pinterest shares), Pinterest boards, teacherspayteachers, Etsy listings, stock sites (Adobe, iStock), nps.gov for dinosaurs.

Google shows an image pack at or near #1 on most of these terms, so image filename, alt text and an indexable full-size image matter as much as the page text. Unicorn SERP also has a short-videos block.
Winning page pattern is a collection hub titled "N [Theme] Coloring Pages (Free PDF Printables)" linking to individual sheets; numbers in titles are common across the top 10.

Long-tail modifiers with "free", "printable", "pdf", "easy", "cute", "preschool" carry SD 15-30 and real volume (e.g. "free printables thanksgiving coloring pages" 1.9k SD 7, "free printable dinosaur coloring pages pdf" 720 SD 15).
Large share of seasonal long tail is character-based (Disney, Bluey, Hello Kitty, Snoopy, Grinch, Nightmare Before Christmas, Stitch, Pokemon) and was excluded per brief.
notes.priorityLogic: Ordered by publishBy: Thanksgiving is live-now (Nov spike), Christmas by Oct 20 to get indexed before the Nov ramp; evergreen dinosaur/unicorn slotted early since they earn year-round; Hanukkah (begins Dec 4, 2026) and Winter by Nov 1; later holidays ~6-8 weeks before their spike month.

collections.title: Thanksgiving Coloring Pages
collections.intro: These free Thanksgiving coloring pages give kids something calm to do while the turkey roasts or the table gets set. Every sheet uses bold outlines and big open shapes, so preschoolers can color without frustration and older kids can add patterns and details. Print a stack for the kids' table, use them in a classroom harvest unit, or send one home with a note about what your child is thankful for. Each page downloads as a free printable PDF.

collections.title: Dinosaur Coloring Pages
collections.intro: Dinosaur fans, this collection is for you. These free dinosaur coloring pages include the big names kids ask about most, like T. rex, triceratops, stegosaurus and spinosaurus, each drawn friendly rather than scary with chunky outlines that are easy to stay inside. They work well for preschool dinosaur units, rainy afternoons, or a dino birthday party activity table. Every page comes with a quick fact you can share while your child colors, plus a free printable PDF.

pages.title: T. rex Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a friendly T. rex standing in a jungle with two palm trees and a small volcano in the background, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11
pages.alt: Friendly T. rex dinosaur standing between palm trees, printable coloring page
pages.description: A friendly T. rex stomps through the jungle past two palm trees and a small volcano. Quick fact to share: a T. rex tooth could be as long as a banana. Kids love comparing their own arms to its famously tiny ones.

pages.title: Triceratops Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a gentle triceratops with three horns and a big frilled neck shield, eating leaves from a low bush, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11

pages.description: This gentle triceratops munches leaves beside a low bush. Count the three horns together, since the name literally means three-horned face. The big neck frill is a great canvas for bright patterns, and scientists still debate what colors it really was.

pages.title: Stegosaurus Coloring Page

pages.title: Spinosaurus Coloring Page

pages.title: Brachiosaurus Coloring Page

pages.title: Ankylosaurus Coloring Page

pages.alt: Easter basket with bow filled with decorated eggs, coloring sheet
pages.description: A woven basket with a big bow holds five decorated eggs. Count the eggs together and design each one differently. The basket weave is great for brown crayon practice, and the grass can be any shade of green.

pages.title: Baby Chick Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a fluffy baby chick standing next to a cracked eggshell with a few spring flowers, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11
pages.alt: Fluffy baby chick beside a cracked eggshell, coloring page
pages.description: A fluffy baby chick stands beside its cracked eggshell. Talk about how chicks hatch after about three weeks of being kept warm. Yellow is the obvious pick, but brown and black chicks are real too.

pages.title: Easter Egg Hunt Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a child with a basket searching a garden with eggs hidden behind a bush, under a tree and in the grass, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11
pages.alt: Child on an Easter egg hunt in a garden, coloring page
pages.description: A child with a basket searches the garden for hidden eggs. Challenge your little one to find and color all the eggs on the page. It's a hidden-picture game and a coloring sheet in one.

pages.title: Spring Lamb Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a fluffy lamb standing in a meadow with a few daisies, fluffy wool drawn as big simple curls, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11
pages.alt: Fluffy lamb standing in a meadow with daisies, coloring page
pages.description: A fluffy lamb stands in a meadow full of daisies. The big wool curls are fun to fill with white, cream or pale gray. Spring is when many lambs are born, which makes this a nice farm lesson tie-in.

pages.title: Easter Cross and Lilies Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a simple wooden cross on a small hill with large Easter lilies at its base and a sunrise behind, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11
pages.alt: Wooden cross with Easter lilies and sunrise, Christian coloring page
pages.description: A simple cross stands on a hill with Easter lilies at its base and a sunrise behind it. It's a good fit for Sunday school or a family devotion time. Soft yellows and oranges in the sky make the scene glow.

pages.title: Bunny Painting Eggs Coloring Page
pages.prompt: children's coloring book page, a cute bunny holding a paintbrush painting stripes on an egg, with a small paint pot and two finished eggs nearby, thick clean black outlines, no shading, no grayscale, white background, simple shapes, large areas to color, portrait 8.5x11
pages.alt: Bunny painting an Easter egg with a brush, coloring page
pages.description: A busy bunny paints stripes on an egg with two finished eggs beside it. Your child gets to finish the job with their own colors. Talk about the steps the bunny follows, which is a fun way to practice sequencing words like first, next and last.
